# Gompertz {#sec-gompertz}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    N_{t+1} = N_t^b K^{1-b}
$${#eq-gompertz}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Gompertz model trajectories for two different b values"
#| label: fig-gompertz-sim

# Function to simulate Gompertz model
simulate_gompertz <- function(N0, b, K, time_steps) {
  # N0: initial population size
  # b: density dependence parameter (0 < b < 1)
  # K: carrying capacity
  # time_steps: number of time steps to simulate

  N <- numeric(time_steps + 1)
  N[1] <- N0

  for (t in 1:time_steps) {
    N[t + 1] <- (N[t] ^ b) * (K ^ (1 - b))
  }

  return(N)
}

# Parameters
N0 <- 1  # Initial population
K <- 10  # Carrying capacity
time_steps <- 50

# Example 1: Lower b (faster convergence to K)
b_low <- 0.3
traj_low <- simulate_gompertz(N0, b_low, K, time_steps)

# Example 2: Higher b (slower convergence to K)
b_high <- 0.8
traj_high <- simulate_gompertz(N0, b_high, K, time_steps)

# Create plot
time <- 0:time_steps
plot(time, traj_low, type = "o", col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7), pch = 16,
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size (N)",
     main = "Gompertz model: effect of b parameter",
     ylim = c(0, K * 1.1), lwd = 2, cex = 0.6)

# Add second trajectory
lines(time, traj_high, type = "o", col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7),
      pch = 16, lwd = 2, cex = 0.6)

# Add carrying capacity line
abline(h = K, col = "gray", lty = 2, lwd = 1)

# Add legend
legend("right",
       legend = c(paste0("b = ", b_low, " (fast)"),
                  paste0("b = ", b_high, " (slow)"),
                  "Carrying capacity (K)"),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8), "gray"),
       lwd = c(2, 2, 1), lty = c(1, 1, 2), pch = c(16, 16, NA),
       cex = 0.9)
```

## Tips and warnings {.unnumbered}
Density dependence is acting on the log
